metadata.title: Mint and Dried Fish Chutney
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/A_P9W

This deliciously spicy chutney prepared by pounding fresh mint leaves with some chilies and roasted dried fish has no frills and fuzz and is absolutely easy to make. The aroma of crushed mint leaves with the pungency of roasted dried fish and the hotness of chilies make the whole combination blissful. This dish can be enjoyed as a side with your meals.
